cited.basis:
The rubric suppressing the Postcommunion is gone. The witness at
benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 43388-43391 suppresses only the Agnus Dei and the
prayer Domine Iesu Christe, qui dixisti, and says nothing about a Postcommunion;
one is then printed at 43583.
